name: zvideo_dd3d_call_clear_zbuffer_rect
description: zVideo_dd3d::CallClearZBufferRect tail-dispatches the supplied rectangle to the runtime-bound Z-buffer clear callback.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs produced symbol ?CallClearZBufferRect@zVideo_dd3d@@YIXPAUzVidRect32@@@Z with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x4a6750 after COFF relocation masking (4 relocation bytes, 10 trim nops; BN size 6, VC size 16).
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a6750 is a single jmp through g_zVideo_pfnClearZBufferRect, forwarding the clear callback ABI result to the caller.
The native dispatch-wrapper smoke binds renderer dispatch and exercises zVideo_dd3d::CallClearZBufferRect with a rectangle, covering the runtime-bound provider call path.
